# O2om (قُوم) — Stand-Up & Focus Ergonomic Health Companion for Windows

> **O2om** (derived from the Arabic imperative **قُوم**, meaning * Stand up!*) is an open-source, high-performance desktop focus and posture companion for Windows built with **Tauri v2** (Rust backend + React 19 / Vite / Tailwind CSS v4 frontend). It features multi-mode interval pacing (Pomodoro, Balanced Stand-Up, Eye Guard 20-20-20), step-by-step guided stretch routines, a floating edge-dockable mini-pill widget, zero-polling physical idle detection, and native Arabic (RTL) & English localization.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **Project Name**: O2om (قُوم)
- **Version**: v4.0.0
- **Target Platform**: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Architecture**: Tauri v2 Multi-Window Topology (main, pill, reak_overlay)
- **Backend Runtime**: Rust 2021 (High-precision Async Engine, SQLite via usqlite, Win32 API, odio audio)
- **Frontend Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand, Lucide React
- **Localization**: Native Arabic (RTL) & English (LTR) via i18next
- **Window Management**: GlazeWM & Komorebi tiling window manager compatibility
- **Memory Footprint**: ~30MB RAM (<5% CPU during active animations, 0% idle)
- **License**: MIT Open Source License

## Core Capabilities
1. **Multi-Mode Ergonomic Engine**:
   - Deep Work Pomodoro (25m work / 5m short break / 15m long break after 4 cycles).
   - Balanced Stand-Up (40m work / 5m break).
   - 20-20-20 Eye Strain Guard (20m work / 20s rest).
   - Custom user-defined intervals.
2. **Interactive Guided Break Overlay**:
   - 5-step guided mobility routine with individual exercise timers and chimes.
3. **Floating Edge-Dockable Mini-Pill**:
   - Frameless, transparent widget with Win32 WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW isolation, auto-snapping, and cursor tucking.
4. **Physical Inactivity Detection**:
   - Hardware idle detection via Win32 GetLastInputInfo that pauses work sessions without halting stretch routines.
5. **SQLite Persistence**:
   - Stores daily goals, completed stands, focus time, and multi-day streaks in local SQLite database.

## Distribution & Setup
- **Standalone Executable**: o2om.exe
- **Windows Setup Installer**: dist-setup/o2om-setup.exe (NSIS)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/BelalWaheed/o2om
